source.note: by hand, 2026-11-04, after rove2-C2/C275/C-fire115 (the turret fired the moment the extractor reached 0.643 of its health, in all three) and C-hold115-shooter (a shooter 160 behind on the ray was blocked by the held Rover in front of it and dealt nothing): the holder stands 140 behind the extractor (shaded in the scan), the shooter 100 behind, in front of it, firing. If the holder is hit when the extractor passes 65 % (the unit scripts' damaged-smoke threshold), the extractor's own state changes with its damage.
